mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the change in FEDFUNDS from the prior month) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because lower interest rates reduce the cost of capital and boost equity valuations through discounted cash flow models.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as businesses anticipate lower sales and cut investment.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 70% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0), the S&P 500 tends to underperform by at least 1% over the next 60 days due to reduced corporate output and earnings growth, signaling an economic slowdown.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 110.0, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days because it signals a weakening real estate market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to lower corporate revenues.
failure_condition: The decline in HOUST over the past two months does not lead to negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI index exceeding 3.0% signals inflationary pressures that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to the expectation of tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as businesses reduce hiring and investment in response to weak demand.
failure_condition: The joint increase in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining retail sales (RSAFS < 380000 million), the S&P 500 tends to underperform by at least 0.5% over the next 60 days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, signaling a weakening economy.
failure_condition: In periods when RSAFS < 380000, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
